sloka: ततो विनिक्षिप्य बलम् सर्वम् नगरगुप्तये ।प्रहस्तः प्रमुखे राज्ञो निषसाद जगाद च ॥६-१२-४॥।।
transliteration: tato vinikṣipya balam sarvam nagaraguptaye ।prahastaḥ pramukhe rājño niṣasāda jagāda ca ॥6-12-4॥।।

translations.english: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.
